//: Capability manifest for <FormHelp> (the .pa-form-help caption) — svelte-pure-admin. FormHelp.svelte renders <small class="pa-form-help {variant} {color} {class}">{children}</small> (tag fixed from <span> to <small> to match the oracle). variant→--{variant}, themeColor→--color-{n}, plus class passthrough + children slot. No info variant (core has none).
